conbody.p: This section describes how to validate your plant’s Wi-Fi network. This is to ensure that the network is robust enough to establish a reliable connection between an , the , and the .

When deploying an in a new location, it is recommended to use the Network Validator tool that is available on the . This tool tests your network setup using four different parameters: signal strength, frequency, internet connectivity, and SMS cloud access.
conbody.note: On iOS devices, the Network Validator tool tests your network setup using only two parameters: internet connectivity and SMS cloud access.

li.p: Log in to the on your mobile device with your credentials. If you are entering information in this account for the first time, you will see the prompt ‘Validate your Wi-Fi network’ on the Dashboard.
li.note: If this is not your first time entering information in this account, then go to Settings and tap Network Validator . In the next screen, tap Validate to run the Network Validator tool.

li.p: Confirm that you passed the last two parameters:

li.note: On iOS devices, the first two parameters cannot be confirmed. Ignore the “Warning” sign.

li.p: For iOS devices, use a Wi-Fi analyzer tool running on an Android or Windows device to confirm your network signal strength.
li.note: The signal strength must be greater than -60dB at the motor location.

ol.li: Tap Done on the top-right of the screen.
Check the back of the plant’s Wi-Fi router to verify that the Wi-Fi access point is 2.4GHz 802.11b/n/g.
